$comment: The remedy table of diagnostics (E50.10, #980): one entry per code a diagnostic stage or a connection test can return. The API returns codes only; the web app and the CLI render these words. `who`: who can fix it (`owner` or `admin`). `link` (optional): where to fix it (`settings`: the owner's Connections page; `admin`: Administration; `provider_console`: the provider's own console). apps/api/test/diagnostics.spec.ts fails when a code a stage can return has no entry here. Plain words; never a provider's message.

CONNECTION_PAUSED.title: Paused
CONNECTION_PAUSED.remedy: Nothing uses this connection while it is paused. Resume it to use it again.

CONNECTION_NEEDS_RECONNECT.title: Needs to be connected again
CONNECTION_NEEDS_RECONNECT.remedy: The service no longer accepts this connection's sign-in. Connect the account again.

GRANT_REVOKED.title: The access was withdrawn
GRANT_REVOKED.remedy: The access was revoked or expired at the service (a password change, a removed app, an expired test grant). Connect the account again.

NO_REFRESH_TOKEN.title: The sign-in cannot be renewed
NO_REFRESH_TOKEN.remedy: The service did not give a way to stay signed in. Connect the account again.

TOKEN_STORE_FAILED.title: The sign-in could not be saved
TOKEN_STORE_FAILED.remedy: The console could not store the renewed sign-in. Connect the account again; if it happens again, tell your administrator.

AUTH_REFUSED.title: The sign-in was refused
AUTH_REFUSED.remedy: The server refused the sign-in it was given. Reconnect it with a valid token or sign in again.

NO_SECRET.title: The saved token is missing
NO_SECRET.remedy: The token or header value saved for this server is gone. Reconnect it with the token.

NOT_INSTALLED.title: Not installed here
NOT_INSTALLED.remedy: This kind of connection is not installed on this deployment. Ask your administrator.

PROVIDER_DISABLED.title: Switched off here
PROVIDER_DISABLED.remedy: Your administrator switched this kind of connection off for this deployment.

APP_NOT_CONFIGURED.title: The administrator's app is not set up
APP_NOT_CONFIGURED.remedy: The deployment's app at the provider is missing its client id or secret. Ask your administrator to finish the setup.

APP_REFUSED.title: The provider refused the deployment's app
APP_REFUSED.remedy: The provider no longer accepts the deployment's app (a changed or expired client secret). Ask your administrator to check it.

REFUSED.title: The provider refused the request
REFUSED.remedy: The provider refused to renew the sign-in. Try again later; if it keeps failing, connect the account again.

UNAVAILABLE.title: The provider could not be reached
UNAVAILABLE.remedy: The service did not answer or answered with an error. Nothing was changed; try again in a few minutes.

UNAUTHORIZED.title: The sign-in was refused
UNAUTHORIZED.remedy: The service did not accept the sign-in. Test again; if it still fails, connect the account again.

FORBIDDEN.title: The provider refused: the permission is missing
FORBIDDEN.remedy: The account signed in but is not allowed to do this. Use "Change what it can do" to ask for the permission again.

PERMISSION_MISSING.title: A permission is missing
PERMISSION_MISSING.remedy: The provider did not grant the permission this capability needs. Use "Change what it can do" to ask for it.

CAPABILITY_OFF.title: Switched off for this account
CAPABILITY_OFF.remedy: This capability is switched off for this connection. Switch it on if you want it used.

API_DISABLED.title: The service is switched off in the administrator's app
API_DISABLED.remedy: The API this capability uses is not enabled in the deployment's project at the provider. Ask your administrator to enable it.

NO_MAILBOX.title: This account has no mailbox
NO_MAILBOX.remedy: The account has no mailbox the service can read (for example a personal account without mail, or one not licensed for it). Switch Mail off for it, or connect another account.

NOT_FOUND.title: Not found at the provider
NOT_FOUND.remedy: The service answered that the resource this check reads does not exist for this account.

FAILED.title: Failed
FAILED.remedy: The service answered in a way the console did not expect. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell your administrator.

RATE_LIMITED.title: Asked to slow down
RATE_LIMITED.remedy: The service asked to slow down. Try again in a minute.

QUOTA_EXCEEDED.title: Quota used up
QUOTA_EXCEEDED.remedy: The quota at the service is used up. It resets later; your administrator may raise it at the provider.

MCP_PROTOCOL.title: Not an MCP server
MCP_PROTOCOL.remedy: The server did not answer in the MCP protocol this console speaks (Streamable HTTP). Check the address.

RPC.title: The server answered with an error
RPC.remedy: The server answered the request with an error. Try again; if it keeps failing, contact whoever runs the server.

REDIRECT.title: The server redirected
REDIRECT.remedy: The server answered with a redirect, which is never followed. Use the server's final address.

INVALID_URL.title: Not a valid address
INVALID_URL.remedy: The address is not a valid URL. Check it.

SCHEME_NOT_ALLOWED.title: Only https is allowed
SCHEME_NOT_ALLOWED.remedy: The address must start with https://.

USERINFO_NOT_ALLOWED.title: A user name in the address
USERINFO_NOT_ALLOWED.remedy: The address must not contain a user name or password. Put a token in the sign-in instead.

QUERY_NOT_ALLOWED.title: A query in the address
QUERY_NOT_ALLOWED.remedy: The address must not contain a query or a fragment. Put a token in the sign-in instead.

PORT_NOT_ALLOWED.title: That port is not allowed
PORT_NOT_ALLOWED.remedy: The address uses a port this console does not connect to.

PRIVATE_TARGET.title: A private address
PRIVATE_TARGET.remedy: The address points at a private or internal network, which is not allowed.

UNRESOLVABLE.title: The address could not be found
UNRESOLVABLE.remedy: The host name could not be resolved. Check the address, or try again later.

HOST_NOT_ALLOWED.title: The host is not on the allowed list
HOST_NOT_ALLOWED.remedy: Your administrator allows only some hosts, and this one is not among them.

TIMEOUT.title: Too slow
TIMEOUT.remedy: The check did not finish in time. Try again in a few minutes.

TOO_LARGE.title: The answer was too large
TOO_LARGE.remedy: The service answered with more than this console reads. Contact whoever runs the service.

NETWORK.title: A network error
NETWORK.remedy: The connection to the service failed. Try again in a few minutes.

ABORTED.title: Stopped
ABORTED.remedy: The check was stopped before it finished. Run it again.

DEADLINE_EXCEEDED.title: Out of time
DEADLINE_EXCEEDED.remedy: The whole check took longer than 20 seconds and the rest was not run. Try again in a few minutes.

SLOW.title: Slow
SLOW.remedy: The checks passed but took more than 5 seconds. The service may be busy; runs that use it may be slow.

UNKNOWN.title: Failed
UNKNOWN.remedy: Something failed that the console has no words for. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell your administrator.
